facts.fact: The government's National Health Compact of 6 December 2025 describes electronic health records in Egypt as at the stage of early pilots, says adoption of electronic medical records in health facilities remains a work in progress, and says rural and public-sector facilities face infrastructure, financing and workforce constraints in adopting digital tools; it gives no count of facilities and does not say which tiers the pilots are in.

systems.owner: Government commitment; to cover facilities of MoHP, MoI, MoHE, MoD, EHA, the private sector and NGOs
systems.tiers: All facility types nationally (a commitment, not stated as built)

systems.owner: MoHP, EHA (to be designed and implemented)

note: The one fact is the compact's general statement on EHR pilots; it is not specific to primary clinics, and the parent may prefer to hold it as context. The compact names no HMIS and commits to a Telemedicine Law by 2030 covering data privacy, digital prescribing and interoperability.
